_sources: anvil: DeployLocal.s.sol deploys MockERC20 AUSD (6 dp) / WMON (18 dp), MockOracleAdapter, mock market. Addresses land in deployments/31337.json.

local._initialIndexPriceWad: 0.029 AUSD/MON, ≈ MON price used in MATH_SPEC examples

params._note: WAD values are decimal strings. Sources: MATH_SPEC §1.3 (funding), §3.3 (risk), §5.3 (vault), §6 (swaps); TEAM_PLAN §7 (launch caps).

swap._maturity: unix seconds, set at deploy: 30 days after listing (MATH_SPEC §6.1)

params._maxPositionSize: A's choice (not in specs): 10% of the per-side OI cap, same ratio as the perp

oracle._maxStalenessSec: 10 s assumes keeper Hermes pushes (R12); 60 s without a Pyth API key (R24). WS-03 owns
oracle._maxDeviationWad: VERIFY: not set in specs; WS-03 (B) to choose

markets._note: Additional perp markets added to an existing deployment by script/AddMarket.s.sol (MARKET_KEY = the key below). Each is a standalone OrderBook + ClearingHouse + keeper-fed TestnetKeeperOracle registered in the existing MarketFactory and authorized on the existing InsuranceFund (PHASES decision 44).

eth._pythFeedId: Pyth Crypto.ETH/USD, from Hermes GET /v2/price_feeds?query=ETH&asset_type=crypto (keepers/ts-fallback DEFAULT_HERMES_URL), 8 Oct 2026. The keeper pushes Hermes prices into the keeper-fed oracle; testnet Pyth is not sponsored-pushed (PHASES decision 10)
eth._baseAsset: No verified WETH on Monad testnet: informational field (IMarketFactory.Market.baseAsset), left address(0). Chainlink ETH/USD is mainnet only (ARCHITECTURE R11)
eth._params: PHASES decision 44. Reference ETH = 2,574.63 USD (testnet Pyth getPriceUnsafe, 8 Oct 2026), MON = 0.0256. tick 0.10 USD = 0.39 bp of ETH, the same relative tick as MON-PERP (1e-6 / 0.0256 = 0.39 bp), so the 5.9 bp A-S spread spans ~15 ticks (MATH_SPEC §4). lot 0.001 ETH = 2.57 USD = the MON-PERP lot in dollars (100 MON = 2.56 USD). Caps = MON-PERP's in dollars (25k MON = 640 USD -> 0.25 ETH; 250k MON = 6.4k USD -> 2.5 ETH). Risk and funding identical to MON-PERP: funding params are per-second or dimensionless (MATH_SPEC §1.3); mmr 10% >> z*sigma*sqrt(tau) for ETH vol (MATH_SPEC §3.4), set by launch liquidity like MON
